definitions.explanation: An online video game genre where large numbers of players interact in a virtual world simultaneously.

examples.japanese: MMOで{友達|ともだち}を{作|つく}る。
このMMOは{月額|げつがく}{課金|かきん}だ。
examples.english: This MMO has a monthly subscription fee.

notes:
MMO stands for 'Massively Multiplayer Online.' It refers to online games where many players share a virtual world.

COMMON TERMS:
- MMORPG (MMO + RPG): massively multiplayer online role-playing game
- MMO{ゲーム}: MMO game

GAME FEATURES:
- {月額|げつがく}{課金|かきん}: monthly subscription
- {基本|きほん}{無料|むりょう}: free to play (F2P)
- ギルド: guild (player group)
- {課金|かきん}アイテム: paid items
- PvP (プレイヤー{対|たい}プレイヤー): player vs. player
- PvE (プレイヤー{対|たい}{環境|かんきょう}): player vs. environment

POPULAR EXAMPLES:
- ファイナルファンタジー14 (FF14)
- ドラゴンクエストX
- {黒|くろ}い{砂漠|さばく} (Black Desert)
